summary: Escuela offline: ruta de formación del Founder (software, IA, web, seguridad, contenido) y sesiones de matemáticas para niños con atención variable, con repaso espaciado.
invariants: Imports nothing outside its folder; all content is bundled so it works offline.
Never diagnoses or labels a child (ADHD or otherwise); it proposes strategies and refers to clinicians.
Claims about techniques carry an evidence level and source; weak evidence (e.g. mental abacus) is stated plainly.
Learner progress is minimal JSON (counts and card schedules): no free text, audio or images.
Not a medical or clinical tool.
reuseNotes: Import from src/index.ts; the host persists LearnerProgress. Janus uses packages/adapters/src/janus-school-tool-adapter.ts. Reusable by Infinity School and any InfinitySeed learning product.
